name: Jason Miller, MBA, CCIFP
headline: Experienced Finance & Operations Executive
about: Entrepreneurial business leader with a demonstrated track record of building and managing teams to successfully implement and utilize business-critical technology and vendor integrations on tight schedules, including ERP, 3rd Party Logistics, E-Commerce, and Marketing Platforms.

experiences.description:
• Migrated accounting from legacy ERP to Sage Intacct to improve financial and management reporting.
• Implemented Miter construction payroll to enhance labor cost data collection and control costs.
• Manage AP and AR to optimize cash flow.
• Worked with project managers to ensure progress billing appropriate to forecasted percent of completion.
• Manage WIP schedule to correctly recognize revenue from contract projects.
• Supervise insurance, banking, and key vendor relationship changes during company sale.
• Monitor key financial ratios to ensure compliance with loan covenants.
• Developed reporting for production of reviewed financials required by bank, captive insurer and surety partners.
• Negotiated business and health insurance policies to reduce cost increases.
• Migrated company data from on-premise server to Microsoft 365 cloud storage.

• Restructured Financial Reporting to gain insight into Sales Channel contribution and profitability.
• Saved 50% on business insurance policies to save by analyzing property replacement costs and adding business interruption.
• Achieved 50% cost savings on DTC shipping and 10% on B2B with renegotiated carrier contracts.
• Evaluated the financial impact of offering a 401K plan and launched the plan with 100% employee participation.
• Created new product development evaluation tools to quantify expected profit and breakeven of new opportunities.
• Updated integration tools for timely and accurate integration with our 3PL partner.
• Spearheaded consolidation of shared storage from Dropbox to Google Workspace.

•	Led Bee’s Wrap operations through transformational growth, acquisition & pandemic response.
•	Manage fulfillment operations for timely and accurate D2C, LTL, and small parcel shipments to deliver 50-60% Gross Margins.
•	Directed post-implementation optimization of NetSuite ERP system and maintain business analytics and reporting for CEO, CFO, and sales decision support.
•	Own supply chain forecasting, sourcing and procurement, inventory management, raw materials testing and vendor relations.
•	Manage working capital to maintain appropriate cash flow.
•	Lead regulatory compliance including protocols for FDA and EU testing of raw materials and finished goods for food contact material product compliance.
•	Created and implemented Good Manufacturing Practices to ensure raw material, production, and finished goods product compliance.

(2015) Managed asset purchase of Chinaberry, Inc. The merger created a multi-title retailer with revenue 5X the revenue of Nova Natural Toys & Crafts (the acquirer.) Implemented two new Shopify+ websites with Klaviyo, managed the production of eight print catalogs, hired key leaders in all departments, migrated warehouse to a bin system in time for the holiday shopping season. (2016) Outsourced fulfillment operations to Newgstics 3PL and call center to 5Star Services. Implemented Emarsys Marketing automation platform. (2018) Migrated from Shopify+ to NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced to create additional efficiencies and reduce overhead. Moved to Radial 3PL to improve fulfillment performance.

Managed marketing, purchasing, customer service, and warehouse staff. (2012) Project managed the migration of novanatural.com to a Magento website integrated with NetSuite using Celigo middleware. Implemented Bronto email marketing system, developing marketing automations that doubled revenue attributed to email. (2015) Migrated E-commerce website from Magento to Shopify integrated with NetSuite and Klaviyo email service provider, reducing technology costs by 67%. Managed circulation, photography, merchandising, and production of Nova Natural Toys & Crafts print catalog.

Managed circulation, production, photography, and merchandising of Nova Natural Toys & Crafts catalog while developing and launching a spin-off business, Taproot Magazine. Developed and launched a new website for novanatural.com using NetSuite SiteCommerce technology.

Developed look and feel of Taproot Magazine, an ad-free bi-monthly magazine and e-commerce shop for the "maker" community. Managed issue design and production. Implemented and managed Shopify website. Manage circulation, email marketing, contracting with printers and distributors, and accounting.

Sourced and procured organic seeds from domestic and international suppliers. Managed seed packing operation. Worked with the fulfillment department to ensure consistent availability of packaged seed. Coordinated with seed rack division for adequate stocks for shipping and replenishing retail partners. Overhauled production projection system to ensure bulk stock remained in storage (and viable) longer. Collaborated with the general manager to create a budget to balance seed availability while optimizing turnover.

Implemented NetSuite ERP and SiteCommerce E-Commerce site, replacing a homegrown system, creating efficiency and a platform for scalable growth. Worked with a key supplier to develop a custom line of flat-pack wooden toy furniture, reducing freight and manufacturing costs. Managed print catalog circulation, photography, copywriting, and production. Selected new merchandise by attending the Nürnberg Toy Fair (Spielwarenmesse).

Sold and serviced accounting software (Dynamics, Macola, Great Plains) and the supporting network infrastructure to small and medium-sized businesses. Developed a managed services division leveraging DSL, VPN, and Citrix technologies for the Real Estate Title Insurance industry. Performed custom Microsoft Access database and design work.
